page.overview:
Who is Bie Breil'lya?

Bie Breil'lya was a Bothan of Clan Alya and first cousin of Tav Breil'lya. In 3 ABY, Breil'lya was captured by the bounty hunter Nariss Siv Loqesh, who planned to use the Bothan as bait to trap other hunters seeking the bounty.
